faq.q: Does Grand Theft Auto VI run at 30fps or 60fps on PS5?
faq.a: Rockstar North co-director Rob Nelson said in press interviews after the August 2026 previews that GTA VI is currently targeting 30 frames per second on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. He would not commit to whether a 60fps option would ship at launch.

faq.q: Does GTA 6 have a performance mode?
faq.a: No performance mode has been confirmed. Nelson said the technical team would need to be consulted on whether a dedicated higher-framerate mode would be available at launch or added later, so this remains undecided as of the report.

faq.q: What resolution does GTA 6 run at on console?
faq.a: Rockstar has not confirmed a resolution target. Some outlets reported an upscaled 4K output during a presentation, but that has not been officially verified by Rockstar itself.

faq.q: Is a 60fps mode planned for GTA VI later?
faq.a: Rockstar has left the door open. Nelson said the option of a future 60fps mode had not been ruled out, without giving a timeline or confirming it will happen.

faq.q: Will GTA 6 run the same on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S?
faq.a: The reported 30fps target applies to both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, based on the same press interviews. No PC version has been announced, so the target does not extend beyond those two consoles.
